scripts.desktop:dev: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Process DevManager.Desktop -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; dotnet clean apps/desktop/DevManager.Desktop.csproj; dotnet watch --no-hot-reload --project apps/desktop/DevManager.Desktop.csproj run"
scripts.sup: concurrently -n api,web,desktop -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web" "npm run desktop:dev"
